title: Translating ICH E6(R3) into Practice: A Site-Centered Operational Quality Management Framework for Shoulder Medical Device Clinical Investigations
subtitle: Master's dissertation, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Universidade de Lisboa (2025/2026)
language_note: Replies to the author in Portuguese. Academic text stays in English, as required by the author's skill thesis-writing (.claude/skills/thesis-writing/SKILL.md), which overrides every generic writing rule.
target_reader: The examination jury of a master's defense: the supervisor and co-supervisor, and an examiner who is either a lecturer in regulation with clinical-trial experience or an orthopedic surgeon with clinical-study experience.
central_claim: ICH E6(R3) and ISO 14155:2026 give the investigational site a larger share of the responsibility for quality, but most of the instruments reviewed here were built for the sponsor. This thesis derives a site-level quality framework that complements the sponsor's system, so that a site can act on the risks the sponsor cannot see in time and can show how it controlled its own conduct.
